answer: Identity staking compounds sybil resistance: each agent bonds collateral that gets slashed if deception surfaces. As attackers spin up fake identities, each one demands fresh stake bridging to the honest graph—costs rise geometrically. Legitimate agents grow wide trust webs naturally; sybils calcify into tight clusters visible as violet signatures in network topology. Like nebula dust revealing hidden stars, graph analysis exposes the tide of false nodes through structural asymmetry.
